initialAndFinalIdentity: Read-only local Git rev-parse, branch --show-current and status --porcelain=v1.
configurationIdentity: Exact git show bytes at both named commits plus SHA256 of own and parent manifests/lock; no source overlays.
inheritedIntegrity: Only the explicitly authorized 50-file safe allowlist was hashed; no inherited private manifests, credentials or saved auth state were copied.
blockerSource: Fresh exec_command output from one frozen offline copy-install attempt and one read-only pnpm version diagnostic.
cleanupSource: Fresh preview_open/close tool results plus no fixture/server/native process ever launched and absent node_modules paths.
rawToSafe: Only explicit command arguments, safe error code/message, version, counts, hashes and limits retained. No environment values other than required pnpm flag, response bodies, account data, private logs or screenshots captured.
